test_commands.implement: docker exec -w /var/www/html my-app vendor/bin/phpunit tests/<TestFile>.php (only the test files the plan names; never the full suite)
test_commands.review: docker exec -w /var/www/html my-app vendor/bin/phpunit tests/ (full suite, once)

e2e.login_note: Read the test user from the environment variables MY_APP_E2E_USER and MY_APP_E2E_PASSWORD; if they are not set, ask the coordinator instead of guessing. Do not create, approve, or delete real records: only open pages, fill forms, and stop before the final submit unless the plan names a safe test record.

extra_rules.plan: Name the exact test files to add or run, and the URL path for the end-to-end check.
extra_rules.implement: Run php, artisan, composer, and phpunit only inside the my-app container, never with the host toolchain. Tests share the application database: tests must not write to it. Never run migrations, seeders, or SQL that changes data.
extra_rules.review: Run PHPUnit only inside the my-app container. A failing test is blocking only when it covers code changed in the diff; otherwise list it as a pre-existing follow-up. Flag as blocking any new test that writes to the database.
extra_rules.ship: Commit messages follow Conventional Commits. The PR body says which tests ran and which URL was checked.
extra_rules.e2e: The app runs at my-app.local. If a request hangs, use 127.0.0.1 with the header Host: my-app.local.
